name: ReturnGuard: return shipping protection
summary: I built nearly all of ReturnGuard, the feature ReturnLogic pivoted its business model around in 2025. Shoppers add return shipping protection at checkout for a small fee, and if they return the item, the label is already paid for.
role: Built nearly all of it: the research spike, the Shopify checkout build, and its monitoring

seo.description: I built nearly all of ReturnGuard, the feature ReturnLogic pivoted its business model around in 2025: a small checkout fee covers the return label.

sections.label: The pivot
sections.html: Retailers paid for returns on both ends: a monthly subscription to ReturnLogic, and the cost of every return label. With ReturnGuard, ReturnLogic earned a share of every protected order instead, and the returns product became free for retailers. Adoption figures aren’t public.

sections.label: Offer, track, redeem
sections.html:
My research spike settled three questions before the build.

QuestionWhat I built
Offer itA Shopify checkout UI extension that adds a protection product, at a fee each retailer sets
Track itA Shopify pixel script that records who added protection
Redeem itProtection comes into ReturnLogic with the order, and when the shopper starts a return, the handoff into their return session covers the label

sections.label: Keeping it earning
sections.html:
Revenue depended on it, so I built health checks and monitoring for the three ways it could break.

  • Protection missingA retailer’s checkout stops offering it.
  • Pixel not firingTracking events stop arriving.
  • Orders not syncingProtected orders don’t reach ReturnLogic.
